Καλλίστρατος δὲ ἐν τῷ α περὶ Ἰλιάδος οὕτως προφέρεται· μηκέτι δὴ νῦν αὐθι λεγώμεθα. καὶ ἔστιν εὖφραδὴς μᾶλλον, ἀλλ’ οὐχ Ἀριστάρχ(ει)ος. Ταῦτα ὁ Λίδυμος. A. Vid. Pluygers. p. 11."}

{"urn": "didymus.schmidt", "edition": "qwen36-didymus_schmidt", "locus": "didymus_schmidt_0133.2", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Γ 10 Διὰ τοῦ ε αἱ Ἀριστάρχου τὸ εὔτε καὶ τὸ ἐτέρωθί που λεγόμενον ‘τῷ δ’ εὔτε πτερὰ γίνεται’ (T 386), ἀντὶ τοῦ· ὡς πτερὰ ἔγινετο ἑλαφρὰ τὰ τοῦ Ἥφαιστον ὅπλα τῷ Ἀχιλλεῖ. ἐν ἐνίαις δὲ τῶν ἐκδόσεων τῇ τε Χίᾳ καὶ τῇ Μασσαλιωτικῇ καὶ τισιν ἄλλαις ἐκ πλήρους ἐγέγραπτο ‘ἥντε ὄρευν κορυφήσι’ παρὰ τὸ εἰωθὸς Ὀμήρῳ. ἐκ πλήρους γὰρ παρ’ ἑκάστα γράφειν ὄρεος. Εἰσὶ δὲ οἱ καὶ ἑτέρως ἀκούονσι τὸ εὔτε ἀντὶ τοῦ ὅτε, καθάπερ καὶ ἐν ἄλλοις ‘εὔτε γὰρ ἥλιος φαίδων’ (Il. A 735) καὶ ‘εὔτ’ ἀστέρ ὑπερέσχε’ (Od. v 93). Λαμβάνουσι δὲ ὑπὸ μίαν περιγραφὴν τὸ ὅλον. ‘εὔτ’ ὄρεος κορυφήσι νότος κατέχεεν ὁμίχλην ποιμέσιν οὔτε φίλην, κλέπτῃ δὲ τε νυκτὸς ἀμείνω, τόσσον τίς τ’ ἐπιλεύσσει, ὅσον ἐπὶ λᾶαν ἴησι.’ ὅπότε ὁ νότος ταῖς τοῦ ὄρους κορυφαῖς κατέχεεν ὁμίχλην τοῖς μὲν ποιμέσιν οὐ προσφιλῇ τῷ δὲ κλέπτῃ νυκτὸς κρείσσονα, τότε ἐπὶ τοσοῦτον δύναται τις βλέπειν, ὅσον ἐστὶ λίθου βολῆς διάστημα. Ἄμεινον δὲ τὸ πρότερον. Τῷ γὰρ ὥσπερ ἀνταποδίδεται τὸ· ὡς ἄρα τῶν ὑπὸ ποσσὶ κονίσσαλος. Ταῦτα ὁ Λίδυμος. A."}

{"urn": "didymus.schmidt", "edition": "qwen36-didymus_schmidt", "locus": "didymus_schmidt_0133.3", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Z 71 Ἀρίσταρχος τεθνηῶτας, ὁ δὲ Ζηνόδοτος· Τρῳῶν ἀμπέδιον συλήσομεν ἑντεα νεκρῶν. Ἀθηνολέους δὲ ἐν τῷ περὶ Ὀμήρου παρατηρήσαντος, ὅτι τῷ μὲν καμάτῳ καὶ ἑαυτὸν ὁ Νέστωρ ὑποβάλλει, λέγων κτείνωμεν, τὸ δὲ κέρδος ἴδιον ποιεῖται τῶν στρατιωτῶν ἐν τῷ συλήσετε, ὁ Καῖρις Ὀμηρικὸν εἶναι φησι τὸν τῆς ἐρμηνείας χαρακτῆρα, ὡς ἐν τούτοις ‘ἄλλοι μὲν — ἑκαστος’ (E 878)· ἴδει γὰρ δέδηρται, ὡς πείθονται ἢ ἀνάπαλιν. καὶ πάλιν ‘ἄλλ’ ἄγεθ’ — πάντες’ (B 139) ‘νῦν μὲν — στρατόν’ (Σ 298) καὶ ἄλλαχοῦ· οὐδὲ γὰρ ἄλλως ἀκμάζει Νέστωρ, ἀλλ’ ὑπὸ γῆρας ἔοικεν ἀπειρηκέναι. Ταῦτα ὁ Λίδυμος. A."}

{"urn": "didymus.schmidt", "edition": "qwen36-didymus_schmidt", "locus": "didymus_schmidt_0133.4", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "H 135 Φιὰ δὲ πόλις τῆς Ἠλίδος, οἱ δὲ τῆς Ἀρκαδίας, παρ’ ἣν ὁ Ἰάρδανος ῥεῖ. ἀλλὰ καὶ ἡ Φιὰ παραθαλάσσιός ἐστι καὶ Ἰάρδανος οὐχ ὁρᾶται ποταμὸς αὐτόθι. ἄμεινον οὖν"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0091.14", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Τοῦ Ἰδοὺ καὶ Λυγέως μὲν οὐκ ἧλατον ἐσθίων,"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0091.15", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Ἐπίσης τῷ Βουθοίνᾳ δὲ καὶ γε τῷ Λυτιέρτῃ."}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0091.17", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Ἐν Λακινίῳ βέβρωκεν Αἰγὼν αὐτὸς ὁ πύκτης."}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0091.18", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Μὴ γὰρ τὸ παξαμάδιον μάζαν, ἀλλ' ἄξαν λέγε,"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0091.19", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Τὸ μάζα γὰρ μὴ ἄξα τις, ἀλλ' ἀπαλὴ καὶ νέα."}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0091.2", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Ὁ Μίλων οὗτος ἀθλητὴς ἐκ Κρότωνος ὑπῆρχε,"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0091.20", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Καὶ τρέχων οὕτως ὄρσει ταύρους ποσίν ἐνίκα"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0091.21", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Καὶ τὰς χηλὰς τὰς τῶν ποδῶν ζώντων χερσὶν ἀνέσπα."}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0091.22", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Τοὺς ταύρους δ' ἐχαρίζετο τοῖς ὤμοις φέρων τούτους"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0091.23", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Φίλους καὶ κόρας γυναιξίν, ὡς τῇ Ἀμαρυλλίδι,"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0091.24", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Ὦς μέμνηται Θεόκριτος οὕτω τὰ ἐπὴ γράφων."}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0091.9", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Διόδωρος καὶ ταύτην δὲ γράφει τὴν ἱστορίαν,"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0098.1", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Οι δὲ δραμόντες ὀδυμοὶ πάντες πρὸς τὸ χαλκεῖον,"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0098.10", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Ὦστε τοὺς ὑστερον εἰπεῖν· Ἡρόδοτε, σοὶς χρόνοις"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0098.12", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Ὡς ἐκπαλαι μὲν τέθνηκε, νῦν δ᾽ ἀνεφάνη πάλιν;"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0098.15", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Θησεὺς υἱὸς ἦν Ἀττικοῦ Αἰγέως καὶ τῆς Αἴθρας,"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0098.16", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Ὡς δὲ ἀνδρείων, ἔφασαν παῖδα τοῦ Ποσειδῶνος·"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0098.17", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Τοὺς θυμικοὺς γὰρ σύμπαντας καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἀνδρείους"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0098.18", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Τίους καὶ φίλους, ἐραστὰς φασὶ τοῦ Ποσειδῶνος."}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0098.2", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Ἀνολζάντες οὐδὲν εὗρον, οὐ νέκυν οὐδὲ ζῶντα."}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0098.21", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Κόρην τινὰ καὶ γήμωσι. καὶ δή ποτε μολόντες"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0098.22", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Εἰς χώραν γῆς τῶν Μολοσσῶν, ὧν βασιλεύς ἦν Ἄιδη,"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0098.23", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Οὕπερ γυνὴ Δημήτηρ ἦν, θυγάτηρ κλῆσιν Κόρη,"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0098.24", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "(Τὰς γὰρ εὐμόρφους Μολοσσοὶ κόρας καλοῦσι πάσας)"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0098.25", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Καὶ κύων δὲ τρικέρηρος, φρικώδης τῷ μεγέθει·"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0098.28", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Τῷ τρικεράρῳ τῷ κυνί, Θησεὺς δ᾽ εἰρκτῇ κρατεῖται."}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0098.29", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Ὡς δ᾽ Ἡρακλῆς ὡς πρὸς αὐτὸν ἦλθε ποτε τὸν Ἄιδη"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0098.3", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Μετὰ δ᾽ ἐπτὰ χρόνους φαίνει πάλιν ὁ Ἀριστέας,"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0098.5", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Καὶ πάλιν ἀφανίζεται τὸ δεύτερον καὶ ὧν ἡσκει."}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0098.6", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Καὶ μετὰ διακόσια δὶς εἴκοσι τὰ ἔτη"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0098.8", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Ὡσπερ φησίν Ἡρόδοτος· εἰ δ᾽ ἀλήθες οὐκ οἶδα."}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0098.9", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Καὶ τίς αὐτὸν ἐγνώρισε, τίς ἐξῆσε τοσούτῳ,"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0570.1", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "τίθενται, ἀνάπαυσίς, βάσις καὶ ῥυθμός. ταῦτα πάντα συν-"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0570.11", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "„ Εἰσὶ γάρ, εἰσίν, ὡς ὁ Κροῖσος πρὶν ἔφη,"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0570.14", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Ἐπεὶ δὲ τοῦτο τοὺς θαναύσους καὶ μόνους"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0570.15", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Μένει πεπηγὸς καὶ κρατεῖ τὰ τῶν νόμων"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0570.16", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Καὶ μέχρις αὐτῶν τῶν τεχνῶν τῶν ἐσχάτων,"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0570.17", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "35 Εἰ τις παραπταίσειεν εἰς βραχὺ μέρος,"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0570.2", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "όλως εἰπεῖν καθαρὰ εἰσιν· ὅπη δὲ τινα καὶ ἑτέρων ἰδίων."}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0570.21", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Τὰ τῶν λόγων ἔχει δὲ πᾶν τοῦναντίον·"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0570.6", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Ὅπως χρυσῶν σε τῶν διδάσκειν τὰ τέκνα,"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0570.7", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "25 Καὶ μητέρες πᾶσαι δὲ σὺν τοῖς πατράσιν"}

{"urn": "joannes-tzetzes.tzetzes-historiae-kiessling", "edition": "qwen36-tzetzes_historiae_kiessling", "locus": "tzetzes_historiae_kiessling_0570.9", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "Οἱ μὲν παλαιοὶ τὰς θαναύσους καὶ λόγων"}

{"urn": "scholia-in-aelium-aristidem.scholia-in-aelium-aristidem-scholia-vetera", "cts": "urn:cts:greekLit:tlg5008.tlg001", "edition": "qwen36-scholia_aristidem_frommel1826-masked", "locus": "scholia_aristidem_frommel1826_0054.10", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "το ὄνομα, ἀφ’ ἧς οἱ πρὸς Χάρ"}

Werf. eme"}

{"urn": "scholia-in-aelium-aristidem.scholia-in-aelium-aristidem-scholia-vetera", "cts": "urn:cts:greekLit:tlg5008.tlg001", "edition": "qwen36-scholia_aristidem_frommel1826-masked", "locus": "scholia_aristidem_frommel1826_0054.29", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "ἔτο τὰ φονικά, ὑψηλὸς δὲ ἦν ὁ"}

{"urn": "scholia-in-aelium-aristidem.scholia-in-aelium-aristidem-scholia-vetera", "cts": "urn:cts:greekLit:tlg5008.tlg001", "edition": "qwen36-scholia_aristidem_frommel1826-masked", "locus": "scholia_aristidem_frommel1826_0054.30", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "λὸς, ἄρειος δὲ διὰ τὸν φόνον, ὃς"}

{"urn": "scholia-in-aelium-aristidem.scholia-in-aelium-aristidem-scholia-vetera", "cts": "urn:cts:greekLit:tlg5008.tlg001", "edition": "qwen36-scholia_aristidem_frommel1826-masked", "locus": "scholia_aristidem_frommel1826_0054.31", "source": "ocr", "license": "PD", "text": "φόνος, ἀφ’ οὗ καὶ ἔναρα τὰ ὕπ-"}
